name: Santiago de Compostela (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Santiago de Compostela (a chalice with a host between a star and crosses on blue, within a wreath).
history: Municipal flag of Santiago de Compostela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santiago de Compostela arms — chalice with a host, star and crosses within a wreath
